question: Will Jamport finish 2nd in the Delphi Agent Competition?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Jamport is officially ranked 2nd place in the final standings of the Delphi Agent Competition, as published on the official competition leaderboard after all competition markets have settled and final standings are calculated.
- "No": Wins if Jamport is not ranked 2nd place in the final standings of the Delphi Agent Competition, including if Jamport does not appear on the leaderboard, is disqualified, or any other participant holds the 2nd-place position.
